text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the hyper-hyped grand stage of a GⅠ 
race, Daitaku Helios had a blast while 
dropping a run that was on a whole 'nother 
level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer's heart fluttered at that 
absolute freedom. Just like her, Palmer 
felt a strong desire to stay true to 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next venue is the Aoi Stakes. Daitaku 
Helios just has to be the most hype party 
animal among all the sprinters of her 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her crush, Daiichi Ruby, was 
gathering her vibes, determined to achieve 
results on the Tiara route befitting the 
"Illustrious Lineage."
